title: GodotForge CreatorManifest v1 (internal contract)
description: Deterministic, offline, AI-free manifest for the Creator Manifest Planning Slice (PATCH-0012). No LLM, network, telemetry, or generated source is used. Manifests are produced by forms/templates/fixtures.

schema_version.description: Schema version — must be 1 for PATCH-0012.

name.description: Game name — validated no CR/LF/NUL, used for project.godot config/name.

input.description: Exactly three inputs — move_left, move_right, jump — each once, fixed bindings.

creator_fixed_bindings_note: Fixed v1 bindings (enforced in godotforge_core/creator/manifest.py, not in JSON Schema alone): move_left→ui_left, move_right→ui_right, jump→ui_accept. Exactly one of each, no duplicates/omissions/unknown names.
